### Authorization Code Flow

### 1. Redirect the user to authorize

GET /oauth/authorize? client_id=YOUR_CLIENT_ID& response_type=code& redirect_uri=https://myapp.com/callback& scope=api& state=random_state_value& code_challenge=CHALLENGE& code_challenge_method=S256
GET /oauth/authorize? client_id=YOUR_CLIENT_ID& response_type=code& redirect_uri=https://myapp.com/callback& scope=api& state=random_state_value& code_challenge=CHALLENGE& code_challenge_method=S256

### 3. Exchange the code for tokens

POST /oauth/token Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded grant_type = authorization_code & code = AUTH_CODE & redirect_uri = https://myapp.com/callback & client_id = YOUR_CLIENT_ID & client_secret = YOUR_CLIENT_SECRET & code_verifier = YOUR_PKCE_VERIFIER
POST /oauth/token Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded grant_type = authorization_code & code = AUTH_CODE & redirect_uri = https://myapp.com/callback & client_id = YOUR_CLIENT_ID & client_secret = YOUR_CLIENT_SECRET & code_verifier = YOUR_PKCE_VERIFIER
{ "access_token" : "eyJhbG..." , "token_type" : "Bearer" , "expires_in" : 3600 , "refresh_token" : "dGhpcyBpcyBh..." }
{ "access_token" : "eyJhbG..." , "token_type" : "Bearer" , "expires_in" : 3600 , "refresh_token" : "dGhpcyBpcyBh..." }

### 4. Use the access token

GET /rest/companies Authorization: Bearer ACCESS_TOKEN
GET /rest/companies Authorization: Bearer ACCESS_TOKEN

### 5. Refresh when expired

POST /oauth/token Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded grant_type = refresh_token & refresh_token = YOUR_REFRESH_TOKEN & client_id = YOUR_CLIENT_ID & client_secret = YOUR_CLIENT_SECRET
POST /oauth/token Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded grant_type = refresh_token & refresh_token = YOUR_REFRESH_TOKEN & client_id = YOUR_CLIENT_ID & client_secret = YOUR_CLIENT_SECRET
